mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.source, o.status, o.buyer_id, o.station_id, o.gun_id, o.gun_no, o.gas_type, o.member_id, o.request_id, o.unit_price, o.order_amount, o.discount_amount, o.pay_amount, o.refunded_amount, o.coupon_id, o.est_volume, o.actual_volume, o.merchant_id, o.pay_channel, o.created_shift_id, o.completed_shift_id, o.proxy_staff_id, o.redeem_staff_id, o.expire_at, o.paid_at, o.completed_at, o.closed_at, o.close_reason, o.exception_note, o.create_time, o.update_time, s.station_name, s.station_code, m.phone as member_phone from gas_order o left join gas_station s on o.station_id = s.station_id left join gas_member m on o.member_id = m.member_id
mapper.select: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.source, o.status, o.buyer_id, o.station_id, o.gun_id, o.gun_no, o.gas_type, o.member_id, o.request_id, o.unit_price, o.order_amount, o.discount_amount, o.pay_amount, o.refunded_amount, o.coupon_id, o.est_volume, o.actual_volume, o.merchant_id, o.pay_channel, o.created_shift_id, o.completed_shift_id, o.proxy_staff_id, o.redeem_staff_id, o.expire_at, o.paid_at, o.completed_at, o.closed_at, o.close_reason, o.exception_note, o.create_time, o.update_time from gas_order o where o.order_id = #{orderId} for update

mapper.update: update gas_order set status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = sysdate(), close_reason = #{closeReason}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'WAIT_PAY'
update gas_order set status = 'PAID', merchant_id = #{merchantId}, pay_channel = #{payChannel}, paid_at = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'WAIT_PAY'
update gas_order set status = 'WAIT_PAY', expire_at = #{expireAt}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'WAIT_CONFIRM'
update gas_order set coupon_id=#{couponId},discount_amount=#{discountAmount},pay_amount=#{payAmount},update_time=sysdate() where order_id=#{orderId} and status='WAIT_CONFIRM' and coupon_id is null
